text:
NSE and BSE are closed today for Diwali Balipratipada, so there is no market wrap, but there is a useful reminder on how holidays work for investors.

• NSE and BSE are closed on Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 for Diwali Balipratipada; trading resumes on Wednesday, 11 Nov, per Business Today and Goodreturns.
• The next NSE trading holidays on the 2026 calendar are 24 Nov (Guru Nanak Jayanti) and 25 Dec (Christmas), per Tata Mutual Fund and Kotak Neo holiday lists.
• A SIP instalment dated on a market holiday is generally processed on the next working day, per Tata Mutual Fund and INDmoney; the exact treatment depends on each AMC's terms.
• Purchase NAV depends on funds being realised before the 3 pm cut-off on a business day, per AMFI's applicable-NAV note.

Our view: a holiday pauses trading, not the investment process. Knowing which dates shift can help avoid surprises on debit dates and allotment timing. This is general information, not advice, and holiday calendars should always be confirmed with the exchange circular.

For practitioners: how do you prepare clients for SIP dates that fall on holidays, especially bank-mandate debits around festival weeks?
